source.name: A non-modal offcanvas panel that allows page scrolling must not trap keyboard focus
source.scope: Real upstream bug (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/33677) at 0bbe45cd977ae69f11b4cdd55e5d5be08e4a137a. Blind to the maintainers' fix 079f2cd90c247225eb71dff4d514faf50f653416; routing auto.

journey.title: Keep editing the report with the help panel open
journey.goal: Tab can reach the amount field while the non-modal panel is open

functionalJourney.title: Open and close the policy help panel
functionalJourney.goal: The panel opens and its close button hides it

guards.title: Close the help panel from the keyboard
guards.goal: The panel's close button is reachable and closes it

plan.root_cause: The offcanvas plugin always enforces a focus trap via _enforceFocusOnElement, regardless of the backdrop setting. When the offcanvas is configured as non‑modal (data-bs-backdrop="false"), this trap prevents tab navigation to underlying fields such as #amount.
plan.repair_strategy: Make focus enforcement conditional on the backdrop configuration. Only call _enforceFocusOnElement when this._config.backdrop is true, preserving modal trapping for the default case while allowing tab escape for non‑modal offcanvases.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Users can tab off the offcanvas panel to reach the amount field and other page controls when the panel is non‑modal, restoring a logical tab order and reducing the number of keystrokes needed to interact with the main form.
functional_risks: If developers inadvertently rely on the focus trap irrespective of the backdrop setting, changing this behavior could allow focus to leave the offcanvas unexpectedly.

The modal‑related ARIA attributes (aria‑modal="true", role="dialog") are left unchanged; assistive technologies may still perceive the offcanvas as modal when backdrop is false, but the primary tab‑navigation issue is resolved.
verification_requirements: With data-bs-backdrop="false", tabbing from the open-help button reaches the #amount field within 6 Tab presses.
With the default backdrop (true), focus remains trapped inside the offcanvas and cannot escape to #amount without explicitly closing it.
Keyboard closing via the Escape key continues to work when keyboard:true.
Panel open/close animations, visibility changes, and ARIA attribute updates remain as originally implemented.
